description: The bar chart compares the performance of two language models, Flan-T5-783M (blue bars) and GPT-4 (red bars), across six different tasks, with performance measured on a scale from 25 to 85. The tasks are grouped into two categories: EM (Exact Match) and F1 (F1 Score), with three tasks in each category. For the TriviaQA (EM) task, Flan-T5-783M achieves a score of 77.3, while GPT-4 scores 77.1. In the HotPotQA (EM) task, Flan-T5-783M scores 37.0, and GPT-4 scores 31.9. For the 2Wiki (EM) task, Flan-T5-783M scores 44.5, and GPT-4 scores 32.5. In the TriviaQA (F1) task, Flan-T5-783M achieves a score of 82.8, and GPT-4 scores 83.8. For the HotPotQA (F1) task, Flan-T5-783M scores 49.7, and GPT-4 scores 43.3. In the 2Wiki (F1) task, Flan-T5-783M scores 53.3, and GPT-4 scores 38.1. The chart shows that GPT-4 outperforms Flan-T5-783M in the TriviaQA (F1) task, while Flan-T5-783M performs better in the other five tasks. The bars are arranged in pairs for each task, with the Flan-T5-783M bar on the left and the GPT-4 bar on the right. The y-axis is labeled with numerical values, and the x-axis lists the tasks.
